build_dataset: build a dataset from a registered name using config and split arguments
register_dataset: register a new dataset class in the DATASET_REGISTRY for use with build_dataset
review_DATASET_REGISTRY: review the DATASET_REGISTRY to see which dataset classes are currently registered
summarize_build_dataset: summarize the build_dataset function that constructs datasets by name from the registry
test_DATASET_REGISTRY: test the DATASET_REGISTRY by registering a mock dataset and calling build_dataset
